title.id: 413 Request Entity Too Large (body terlalu besar)

cause.en: The request body is too large.

user_fix.en: Reduce the size of the request body: shorter context, fewer or smaller attachments.
user_fix.id: Perkecil body request: konteks lebih pendek, lampiran lebih sedikit atau lebih kecil.

operator_fix.en: Check body size before sending and trim history automatically.
operator_fix.id: Cek ukuran body sebelum mengirim dan pangkas riwayat secara otomatis.

cause.en: The request was well formed but could not be followed because of semantic errors or model hallucinations.
cause.id: Request formatnya benar tapi tidak bisa dijalankan karena kesalahan makna atau halusinasi model.

user_fix.en: Check the data for correctness and completeness, or retry the request.
user_fix.id: Cek kebenaran dan kelengkapan data, atau ulangi request.

operator_fix.en: Retry a limited number of times; if it repeats, log the payload for review.
operator_fix.id: Retry dengan jumlah terbatas; kalau berulang, catat payload untuk ditinjau.

cause.en: A dependent request failed, for example a Remote MCP server with an authentication problem.
cause.id: Request turunan gagal, misalnya server Remote MCP yang bermasalah di autentikasi.

user_fix.en: Check the credentials and URL of the remote MCP server or tool you attached.
user_fix.id: Cek kredensial dan URL server MCP remote atau tool yang kamu pasang.

operator_fix.en: Test each remote tool separately before attaching it to model calls.
operator_fix.id: Uji setiap tool remote secara terpisah sebelum dipasang ke panggilan model.

cause.en: A custom status: the flex tier is at capacity and the request was not processed.
cause.id: Status khusus: flex tier sedang penuh dan request tidak diproses.

operator_fix.en: Treat 498 as retryable in your HTTP client; many clients only retry 429 and 5xx by default.
operator_fix.id: Masukkan 498 sebagai status yang boleh di-retry di klien HTTP; banyak klien hanya retry 429 dan 5xx secara default.

cause.en: A generic server-side error. Requests that return server error codes are not charged.
cause.id: Error umum di sisi server. Request yang berakhir dengan kode error server tidak ditagih.

user_fix.en: Try again later; contact support if it persists.
user_fix.id: Coba lagi nanti; hubungi dukungan kalau terus terjadi.

operator_fix.en: Retry with backoff and a cap; 502 and 503 are also documented as temporary.
operator_fix.id: Retry dengan backoff dan batas; 502 dan 503 juga disebut sementara di dokumentasi.
